# Apple-created existing-HFS edit references

These are immutable native references, captured on disposable GitHub-hosted VMs
by [run 38142112333](https://github.com/deploymenttheory/go-apfs-v3/actions/runs/38142112333)
at commit `b74c38706c3f2cd24e63ac0de3066de193c87143`. The HFS capture, portable
editing and subsequent native/Go/native qualification jobs all passed on that
run. The parent workflow also tests separate existing acceptance families.

| Directory | macOS | Build | Architecture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `macos-15` | 15.7.9 | 24G830 | arm64 |
| `macos-26` | 26.6.2 | 25G83 | arm64 |
| `macos-27` | 27.0.1 | 26A434 | arm64 |

Each directory contains Apple-formatted nonjournaled HFS+ and HFSX disks, their
native peak/final states, complete observations, exact executed recipes, command
transcripts and tool hashes. Each gzip expands to a complete 64 MiB raw volume;
the whole retained family occupies about 10 MiB. No archives or expectations
were generated by Go. Files were copied unchanged from the run artifacts.

The recipe fills with 32 KiB guards until an actual write returns ENOSPC, removes
alternating guards, and creates fragmented data/resource forks with more than
eight native extents. Native replacements grow, shrink and truncate files,
replace an independent fork and clear active compression. Hard-link aliases,
attributes and a signed universal application supply preservation controls.
The original extents trees use 1,024-byte nodes and 12 nodes; portable growth must
extend their actual storage. The manifests retain OS-specific observations.

The fixed modification clock also supplies birth/access times explicitly in
native controls. Apple otherwise moves HFS+ birth time when backdating mtime.
Native ctime remains its actual wall-clock observation; portable ctime is checked
against the explicit offline clock rather than substituted into the reference.

`manifest.json` binds compressed/decoded image hashes, scripts and command
transcripts. Portable tests verify those hashes before using the evidence. The
retained scripts describe provenance and are never executed by replay.

Run `go test -count=1 -run '^TestNativeHFSImageEditing$' ./acceptance` from the
repository root. Replay takes about 19 seconds on the development Mac and uses
ordinary files only. CI separately captures new sources on all three native
versions and requires Linux/Windows/macOS outputs to pass Apple checks, mounted
readback, signatures and continued native use. Fresh captures never silently
replace these references. Native execution is confined to disposable CI VMs.
